Class AbstractGameSession

java.lang.Object
aslframework.game.session.AbstractGameSession
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameSession
Direct Known Subclasses:
PracticeSession
public abstract class AbstractGameSession extends Object implements GameSession
Abstract base for all game sessions, providing shared infrastructure.

Handles the parts every session needs:

  • Holding the recognizer, library, and scoring strategy
  • The allAttempts list and its accessor
  • evaluate(String, List) — the single place where recognition happens
  • requireNotFinished() — guard reused by all subclass attempt methods
  • A GameEventListener that subclasses fire for UI/logging callbacks

Subclasses implement the mode-specific attempt flow, letter progression, and result construction.

    • evaluate

      protected AttemptRecord evaluate(String letter, List<HandLandmark> userLandmarks)
      Runs recognition for the given letter and landmarks, creates an AttemptRecord, appends it to the shared attempt list, and returns it.

      This is the single call-site for recognition across all session types — neither subclass duplicates this logic.

      Parameters:
      letter - the ASL letter being attempted
      userLandmarks - 21 hand landmarks from the camera
      Returns:
      the created AttemptRecord
